title: 36 Hours in Detroit
abstract: The city may be shrinking but there are plenty of reasons to visit, from restored film palaces to historic architecture. And then there’s always the barbecue.

title: 36 Hours in Detroit
abstract: No urban enthusiast will want to miss the recovery that Detroit is now attempting.

title: 36 Hours in San Francisco
abstract: Much of the city's waterfront has become another of its pleasures.

title: 36 Hours in San Francisco
abstract: Along with the well-known heights and sights, a weekend in San Francisco can take in the city’s maritime heart — its waterfront, much of which has been refurbished.

title: 36 Hours in Milan
abstract: Italy’s most cosmopolitan city refuses to coast on its legendary treasures.

title: 36 Hours in Milan
abstract: With new museums and restaurants, and an ambitious center-city development nearing completion, the future is already on display in Milan.

title: 36 Hours Niagara Falls
abstract: It’s best to go back and forth between Canada and New York to get the best of both Niagaras.

title: 36 Hours in Niagara Falls
abstract: In Canada you get views and hooplah; in New York, quiet exploration. To get the best of both Niagaras, hop back and forth.
